youtube_description:
In this vlog I take you on my international plane trip to see my granny in Dublin, Ireland. She is not well, so I went with my mom and little brother, Mark Adam, to see her. This is my trip on the airplane from Houston airport to Dublin airport. 

Next week, I will show you what I did while in Ireland!

If you like this, watch my other travel videos - http://bit.ly/2F5HPq2
